stated: The Conservative Party will extend the UK Shared Prosperity Fund for three years at the next Spending Review, before using this funding to support UK-wide National Service, focusing on increasing life chances, civic pride, and skills.

source.quote: Extend the UK Shared Prosperity Fund for three years at the next Spending Review, before using this funding to support UK-wide National Service. Both schemes will involve funding community groups focused on increasing life chances, instilling civic pride and boosting people’s skills.

bearing_set.reason: The policy explicitly targets 'skills', 'life chances', and opportunity via a National Service programme, and the UKSPF itself funds skills and employability schemes — both the extension and the eventual repurposing directly affect FE/skills provision and opportunity for young people.

The UKSPF currently funds employment support and local business development; redirecting it to National Service shifts resources away from direct employment pathways, with a concrete mechanism affecting employment-rate and job-quality indicators for UKSPF-recipient communities.

UKSPF is a multi-hundred-million-pound place-based economic investment fund targeting left-behind communities; extending it continues investment in local productivity, business support, and economic opportunity.

UKSPF explicitly targets less prosperous areas of the UK to reduce regional and inter-community economic gaps; the 'life chances' framing reinforces a focus on those with fewer opportunities — a direct regional/distributional inequality effect.

'Civic pride' is named as an explicit policy objective; a National Service scheme built around civic participation directly maps to social trust, civic engagement, and sense of belonging — the core O15 indicators.

'National Service' as a term conventionally implies compulsory participation for eligible individuals; state-mandated service bears on freedom from state coercion regardless of how civic or skills-oriented the programme is — a real O10 bearing conditional on the compulsion mechanism.

membership_note: Policy has two distinct phases — UKSPF extension (economic/opportunity investment) and transition to National Service (skills, civic, and compulsion dimensions) — justifying five real bearings across prosperity, inequality, opportunity, cohesion, and personal liberty.
